arxiv-1810-11946.title: Neural source-filter-based waveform model for statistical parametric speech synthesis
arxiv-1810-11946.creator: Xin Wang, Shinji Takaki, Junichi Yamagishi \sthanks This work was partially supported by JST CREST Grant Number JPMJCR18A6, Japan and by MEXT KAKENHI Grant Numbers (16H06302, 16K16096, 17H04687, 18H04120, 18H04112, 18KT0051), Japan
arxiv-1810-11946.description: Abstract Neural waveform models such as the WaveNet are used in many recent text-to-speech systems, but the original WaveNet is quite slow in waveform generation because of its autoregressive (AR) structure. Although faster non-AR models were recently reported, they may be prohibitively complicated due to the use of a distilling training method and the blend of other disparate training criteria.

arxiv-1906-09451.title: Conjectures P1-P15 for hyperbolic Coxeter groups of rank 3
arxiv-1906-09451.creator: Jianwei Gao, Xun Xie
arxiv-1906-09451.description: Abstract . We prove Lusztig’s conjectures P1-P15 for hyperbolic Coxeter groups of rank 3. Our proof enables us to give a description of the 𝐚 \mathbf{a} -function and Kazhdan-Lusztig cells for these Coxeter groups. 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification Primary 20C08; Secondary 20F55 1.

arxiv-2211-13173.title: Average Token Delay: A Latency Metric for Simultaneous Translation
arxiv-2211-13173.creator: Yasumasa Kano, Katsuhito Sudoh, Satoshi Nakamura
arxiv-2211-13173.description: Abstract Simultaneous translation is a task in which translation begins before the speaker has finished speaking. In its evaluation, we have to consider the latency of the translation in addition to the quality. The latency is preferably as small as possible for users to comprehend what the speaker says with a small delay.

arxiv-2307-11250.title: Active Q-switched X-Ray Regenerative Amplifier Free-Electron Laser
arxiv-2307-11250.creator: Jingyi Tang, Zhen Zhang, Jenny Morgan, Erik Hemsing, Zhirong Huang
arxiv-2307-11250.description: Abstract Despite tremendous progress in x-ray free-electron laser (FEL) science over the last decade, future applications still demand fully coherent, stable x-rays that have not been demonstrated in existing X-ray FEL facilities. In this Letter, we describe an active Q -switched x-ray regenerative amplifier FEL scheme to produce fully coherent, high-brightness, hard x rays at a high-repetition rate.

arxiv-2408-16358.title: Irradiation-driven mass transfer for massive companion stars in supersoft X-rays sources
arxiv-2408-16358.creator: Weitao Zhao, Xiangcun Meng, Yingzhen Cui
arxiv-2408-16358.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Weitao Zhao, Xiangcun Meng, Yingzhen Cui. Supersoft X-ray sources (SSSs) have been proposed as one of the progenitors for Type Ia supernovae. However, the exact origin of the quasi-periodic variability in the optical light curve remains a mystery. In this work, our goal is to investigate the effect of the feedback of an evolved main-sequence companion star on X-ray irradiation and find whether periodic X-ray irradiation of the companion star could reproduce periodic mass transfer.

arxiv-2412-04745.title: Finiteness and finite domination in stratified homotopy theory
arxiv-2412-04745.creator: Marco Volpe
arxiv-2412-04745.description: Abstract In this paper, we study compactness and finiteness of an ∞ \infty -category 𝒞 \mathscr{C} equipped with a conservative functor to a finite poset P P . We provide sufficient conditions for 𝒞 \mathscr{C} to be compact in terms of strata and homotopy links of 𝒞 → P \mathscr{C}\rightarrow P .

arxiv-2512-12004.title: EnviroLLM: Resource Tracking and Optimization for Local AI
arxiv-2512-12004.creator: Troy Allen
arxiv-2512-12004.description: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed locally for privacy and accessibility, yet users lack tools to measure their resource usage, environmental impact, and efficiency metrics. This paper presents EnviroLLM, an open-source toolkit for tracking, benchmarking, and optimizing performance and energy consumption when running LLMs on personal devices.

pmc-11312691.title: Carbon Source and Substrate Surface Affect Biofilm Formation by the Plant-Associated Bacterium Pseudomonas donghuensis P482
pmc-11312691.creator: Magdalena Rajewska, Tomasz Maciąg, Magdalena Narajczyk, Sylwia Jafra, Jintae Lee
pmc-11312691.description: The ability of bacteria to colonize diverse environmental niches is often linked to their competence in biofilm formation. It depends on the individual characteristics of a strain, the nature of the colonized surface (abiotic or biotic), or the availability of certain nutrients.

pmc-11453415.title: 12389 Viral Insulin/IGF-1-like Peptides: A New Dimension In Understanding The Insulin/IGF System
pmc-11453415.creator: M Chrudinova, A Chuard, F Zhang, Y D Dogru, P De Meyts, J K Kim, N Kirk, J Jiracek, R D DiMarchi, E Altindis
pmc-11453415.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Viral Insulin/IGF-1-Like Peptides: A New Dimension in Understanding the Insulin/IGF System Martina Chrudinova, Aurelien Chuard, Dogus Dogru, Nicholas Kirk, Pierre De Meyts, Jason Kim, Richard Di Marchi, Jiri Jiracek, Emrah AltindisMammals have separate insulin and IGF-1 receptors, and in most species, one insulin and two IGFs interact with them. The mammalian Insulin receptor (IR) primarily controls metabolism, while the insulin-like growth factor-1 (IGF-1) receptor (IGF1R) regulates cell apoptosis, growth, and prenatal and postnatal differentiation.

pmc-11524335.title: Anesthetic Implications of Factor XI Deficiency: A Clinical Case Study and Review of Literature
pmc-11524335.creator: Pedro-Rafael Martinez-Lopez, Alejandro Barroso-Gonzalez
pmc-11524335.description: Factor XI deficiency, a rare but significant coagulopathy, poses unique challenges in perioperative management, particularly in obstetric settings. This review provides an in-depth exploration of the pathophysiology, diagnosis, and anesthetic implications of factor XI deficiency, thereby emphasizing the useful role of anesthesiologists.

pmc-11537865.title: An exploratory cross-cultural study of community-based health literacy interventions to promote the mental well-being of disadvantaged and disabled young Africans: a multi-method approach
pmc-11537865.creator: Darren Sharpe, Mohsen Rajabi, Liliana Galicia Mesa, Ainul Hanafiah, Chinwe Obuaku-Igwe, Julia Davidson, Katongo Chileshe
pmc-11537865.description: BackgroundThis study explores the impact of community-based health literacy interventions on the health and mental well-being of disadvantaged young Africans in Zambia, Sierra Leone, Rwanda, and South Africa. The pandemic has exacerbated mental health problems amongst children and young people, underscoring the urgent need for equitable access to mental healthcare resources.

pmc-12554072.title: Dog deworming by smart collar: a 24-month field evaluation from a One Health prospective, randomized, double masked trial
pmc-12554072.creator: Shijie Yang, Yuancheng Yang, Xuenian Xu, Chenqing Sun, Xiaojuan Zhang, Fan Li, Jianhong Hu, Baolin Zhong, Liying Wang, Ying Wang, Shuai Han, Chuizhao Xue, Xu Wang, Baixue Liu, Chun Fang, Guoxiang Kui, Zonglin Shen, Yu Feng, Shizhu Li, Ning Xiao, Yuhua Li
pmc-12554072.description: BackgroundEchinococcosis constitutes a major zoonotic parasitic disease with profound public health and socioeconomic implications. Dog deworming remains a cornerstone intervention endorsed by World Health Organization. This study comparatively assessed automated vs. manual praziquantel (PZQ) bait delivery systems for dog echinococcosis control.

pmc-12996157.title: High-dose aztreonam potentiates the combined antimicrobial activity of ceftazidime-avibactam against extensively drug-resistant New Delhi metallo-β-lactamase positive Pseudomonas aeruginosa in severe pneumonia treatment: the first global case report
pmc-12996157.creator: Yifeng Liu, Cuiju Mo, Meng Li
pmc-12996157.description: Extensively drug-resistant Pseudomonas aeruginosa (XDR-PA) present increasing incidence and limited therapeutic options, emerging as one of the serious public health threats worldwide. Here, we report a case of an elderly male patient with multiple primary diseases who developed a severe pneumonia following long-term bedrest due to an accidental tumble after cerebral infarction.

pmc-13239514.title: Emergency Department-initiated standard versus high-dose buprenorphine induction (ENVISION): a randomised clinical trial protocol
pmc-13239514.creator: Kathryn Hawk, Andrew Herring, Marek Chawarski, Erik S Anderson, Michael Baumann, Alyrene Dorey, August F Holtyn, Christopher Jones, Shara Martel, Patricia Owens, Kaitlin Kmiecik, Tania D. Strout, Peter Taillac, Michelle Lofwall, Sharon L Walsh, Gail D’Onofrio
pmc-13239514.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). IntroductionThe initiation of buprenorphine for patients with opioid use disorder (OUD) in the emergency department (ED) has been associated with improved outcomes including reduced ED visits and increased treatment engagement. pmc-13250641.title: Integrative single-cell and spatial transcriptomics analysis reveals a baicalein-responsive 10-gene signature for non-small cell lung cancer
pmc-13250641.creator: Donghao Wu, Cheng Liu, Longsheng Zhan, Min Liang, Qianqian Li, Qinghai Lian
pmc-13250641.description: Highlights•Single-cell atlas reveals baicalein targets enriched in proliferating TAMs and T cells.•32-gene signature functional analysis highlights cell cycle, oxidative stress and p53 pathways.•SHAP‑enhanced machine learning identifies 10‑gene signature with high accuracy.•Spatial transcriptomics confirms tumor‑specific upregulation of all ten genes.•Molecular dynamics simulations validate stable binding of baicalein to TOP2A, CCNB2, MB and AURKB.

pmc-13317342.title: Racism and anti-racism in medical education: a cross-sectional study of Finnish medical students’ perspectives
pmc-13317342.creator: Emma D Arnell, Jaana Simola, Pia Mikander
pmc-13317342.description: BackgroundRacism negatively impacts health, and it has both structural and interpersonal manifestations in medicine. In Finnish medical education, diversity, equity, and inclusion work is still in its infancy. This is the first study examining Finnish medical students’ perspectives on racism and anti-racism during their studies.MethodsAn online survey was distributed to medical students across Finland.

pmc-13375492.title: Effects of 6-week high-intensity interval training and moderate-intensity continuous training on classroom attention in children: a randomized controlled study
pmc-13375492.creator: Yijie Ma, Yaqin Xu, Rangxi Jin, Dexin Wang, Chao Chen, Na Jiang, Xinbo Zhang
pmc-13375492.description: IntroductionAlthough physical activity has been shown to enhance children’s cognitive and attentional functions, the comparative effects of High-Intensity Interval Training (HIIT) and Moderate-Intensity Continuous Training (MICT) on classroom attention behaviors remain unclear. This study compared the effects of 6-week HIIT and MICT interventions on children’s classroom attention behaviors using AI-based behavior capture in an ecological environment.

pmc-13558143.title: Development and validation of a predictive model for myocardial injury in children with pneumonia based on interpretable machine learning
pmc-13558143.creator: Shuai Zhang, Jianming Zhang
pmc-13558143.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). ObjectiveThis study aimed to identify independent factors for pneumonia-related myocardial injury in children, and construct and validate a risk prediction model and stratification system to enable early screening of high-risk patients and guide individualized clinical interventions.MethodsA total of 222 children hospitalized with pneumonia from January 2023 to May 2026 were enrolled in this retrospective study and equally divided into myocardial injury and non-injury groups (111 cases per group). Admission baseline clinical and laboratory data were collected.
